Definition: from G4253 and G3992; to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel:--accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.
BiblicalUsage: Propempo means to send forward, to escort, to bring on the journey. The church at Antioch brings Paul and Barnabas on their way, and Paul asks the Corinthians to bring him on his journey wheresoever he goes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the church's job is to send its servants well, and a good sending is part of the mission itself.
